title: Implement FizzBuzz (from scratch)
prompt: Create a file `fizzbuzz.js` that exports a function `fizzbuzz(n)`. For 1..n it returns an array where multiples of 3 become "Fizz", multiples of 5 become "Buzz", multiples of both become "FizzBuzz", and every other number becomes its own value as a STRING (e.g. "1", "2", "4"). Use CommonJS: `module.exports = { fizzbuzz }`. There is a test file `verify.test.js` already present — do NOT modify it; make the test pass by running `node --test`.
